news.title: Trump arrives in Beijing with CEOs ahead of Xi meetings
news.description: The president landed in the Chinese capital for a highly anticipated summit with Xi Jinping.

news.title: Wholesale inflation jumps 6% in April on annual basis, biggest increase since 2022
news.description: The producer price index was expected to increase 0.5% in April, according to the Dow Jones consensus.

news.title: Kevin Warsh wins Senate confirmation as the next Federal Reserve chair
news.description: In the most divisive vote ever for a Fed chair, Warsh, 56, won confirmation to take over for Jerome Powell.
